hero.heading: Hey! I’m imad
hero.description: AI/ML Engineer with a background in Data Science. Experienced in building AI-powered solutions such as intelligent chatbots, data-driven decision systems. Skilled in programming, database management, and machine learning with a strong focus on practical applications of AI. Proficient in data analysis, automation, and integrating AI into real-time workflows. Certified in AI Engineering, Python Development, and Applied Data Science.

about.title: I AM AVAILABLE FOR AI ML PROJECTS
about.description: I am a Data Science graduate with a strong interest in artificial intelligence and machine learning. I enjoy building practical software solutions, exploring new technologies, and continuously improving my skills through hands-on projects and real-world applications.

details.title: Voice-to-Voice Bot for Shopping Mall Information Retrieval
details.description: Built a voice-based chatbot that retrieves shopping mall information through real-time SQL query generation. Integrated LangChain for LLM-powered reasoning, Faster-Whisper for speech-to-text, and Edge TTS for voice responses. Enabled natural, continuous conversation flow using speech recognition and dynamic SQL execution.

details.title: Intelligent AI Customer Support Chatbot
details.description: Built a conversational AI chatbot capable of understanding natural language queries and retrieving accurate information from databases and knowledge bases using LangChain and LLMs like GPT-4o-mini. Designed multi-step agents with schema retrieval and SQL execution tools for real-time responses. Integrated with web applications for interactive customer support. Video demo available on YouTube.

details.title: AI Job Application Assistant
details.description: Developed an intelligent job search assistant connecting to platforms like LinkedIn, Glassdoor, and Indeed via APIs and Selenium automation. Implemented CV parsing using LLMs to extract skills and keywords for personalized job matching. Applied Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to improve job relevance and built a chatbot interface for resume uploads and curated job recommendations.

allExperience.companyDescription:
Working on AI-driven systems leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Ollama, and relational databases. Developed Python-based automation scripts and intelligent data workflows for production-level applications. Implemented and optimized LLM-based applications using Ollama for local inference. Collaborated with the AI team to enhance multi-agent and RAG-based system architectures.

Technologies: Python, Ollama, LangChain, MySQL, LLMs, Flask.

Built a SQL-based Question Answering System using LLMs (LLaMA 3, Mistral) to retrieve insights from structured databases. Designed two pipelines: a simple chain-based Q&A system and a multi-step SQL Agent leveraging LangChain. Integrated LangChain with MySQL for secure, multi-query reasoning workflows.

Technologies: Python, LangChain, LLaMA, Mistral, MySQL, Flask.

Built robust web scraping pipelines using Selenium, Requests, and BeautifulSoup to extract structured data from dynamic websites. Automated data collection workflows for consulting projects, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort. Cleaned, parsed, and stored extracted data into CSV formats for further analysis.
